newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin price recovers two cents to 13.71 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin price recovers two cents to 13.71 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended two cents higher at 13.71 ringgit ($5.43) a kg on Monday, with the market following an overnight rebound on the London Metal Exchange (LME).
"There was some good buying because the LME finished up," said a tin trader in Malaysia.
He said the resistance level for the tin price was still 14 ringgit a kg, although achieving this would depend very much on the strength of copper on the LME.
There were bids for 125 tonnes on the local market, against offers for 113.
Turnover totalled 118 tonnes against 104 on Friday. Buyers were from Japan, Europe and Malaysia. The local premium against London fell to $30 a tonne from $35 previously.
